scope: Registered frozen CO paired-history diagnostic and implementation before any research sample or checkpoint execution; no empirical verdict or model run by reviewer.
checks: v2 preserves the frozen three-seed D64-float32 primary gate, 384 triples per seed, zero training updates, and one registered stopping branch; v1 remains a retained, unrun version.

A, B, and C share the complete suffix and maintain the registered opposite-b and same-b physical relations. Their separate full-batch forwards align corresponding rows; a full A batch is repeated bitwise.

Only bitwise equality of complete finite hidden states counts as merger. Float64-distance curves, D16, original logits, and the previously fitted linear probe are descriptive controls and cannot substitute for the primary gate.

The implementation rejects nonfinite states, logits, distances, and readouts, checks post-merger absorption, freezes checkpoint and probe hashes, and saves raw trajectories and input arrays without overwrite.

The single-process reproduction path regenerates all three seeds, replays all 12 model conditions, compares bitwise flags, independently recomputes physical states, merger counts, seed statistics, and readout metrics from raw arrays.
limits: This is a pre-run design and code review only. Engineering tests and formal execution are separate evidence; no Gate 1 or information-absence claim is established.
